subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw publish `sessionActions`, `allowChatNavigation`, and context-window information as a supported Plugin SDK/Gateway contract for sandboxed external tabs?
rationale: This is a new cross-plugin capability and security boundary, so code review cannot determine the intended permanence, ownership, or compatibility commitment from the PR alone.

options.title: Approve a narrow supported contract
options.body: Retain descriptor-scoped actions and navigation, but make the Gateway derive context state and document the compatibility and security guarantees before merge.

options.title: Keep tabs read-only
options.body: Retain the existing gateway-auth tab model and route mutation workflows through an already-approved plugin or core surface instead.

options.title: Request a different generic seam
options.body: Define a narrower owner-approved SDK primitive before exposing any mutation bridge to sandboxed tabs.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow supported contract
recommendation.body: Retain descriptor-scoped actions and navigation, but make the Gateway derive context state and document the compatibility and security guarantees before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged gateway-auth tab implementation is the direct security and ownership boundary that this PR extends.
